name: Beef Heart
description: Beef heart (Cor bovis) is a highly specialized, dense myogenic organ characterized by an intense metabolic profile. As a constantly active contractile tissue, it constitutes a unique biological matrix enriched with endogenous Coenzyme Q10 (ubiquinone), collagenous protein scaffolds, and a dense repository of hematopoietic cofactors. This organ serves as an elite bioenergetic substrate designed to optimize mitochondrial respiratory efficiency and sustain cardiovascular structural integrity.
macroIntro: A highly efficient, protein-centric metabolic blueprint, delivering high-density anabolic substrates without glycemic disturbance.
microIntro: A magnificent repository of bioavailable cardiometabolic enzymes and neuro-regulatory cofactors that reinforce foundational energy production.

healthBenefits: Mitochondrial ATP Optimization: Synergistic action of CoQ10 and Riboflavin streamlines cellular respiration, enhancing physical stamina and reducing metabolic fatigue.
Hematological and Oxygen Efficiency: High-density heme iron and B12 facilitate rapid erythropoiesis, correcting indicators of systemic tissue hypoxia.
Cardiovascular Lipid Protection: Endogenous ubiquinone (CoQ10) provides critical defense against free-radical peroxidation of myocardial vascular lipid structures.
Connective Tissue Reinforcement: Collagen-precursor amino acids assist in the structural stabilization of vascular boundaries and articular connective architectures.
precautionsIntro: Due to dense myogenic microstructure and high biological activity, specific preparatory protocols are advised:
precautions: Lipid Management: External saturated fat deposits must be mechanically excised to ensure the metabolic efficiency of the lean muscle matrix.
Purine Content: As a high-density muscular tissue, purine concentrations necessitate moderate intake for patients with hyperuricemia or gout susceptibility.
Proteolytic Preparation: The dense collagenous structure requires precise thermal processing (slow-braising) or mechanical thinning to facilitate optimal proteolysis and gastrointestinal digestion.
